The main takeaway from our work is that
the binding sites of the carbohydrate-binding module and domain C are not mutually exclusive and can bind substrates simultaneously.
the domain C of pullulanases can be a potential binding site for carbohydrates, in addition to the catalytic site and CBM48.
pullulanases have more than one binding site for carbohydrate, and these sites can be located in the catalytic domain or in the carbohydrate-binding module.
